description_en: Sets the health status of an ECS instance in a scaling group
description_zh: 设置伸缩组内ECS实例的健康状态
kebab_example: aliyun ess set-instance-health --instance-id i-bp1ap6bro51a7fsa0000 --health-status Healthy --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetInstanceHealth

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance in the scaling group
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The health status that you want to set for the instance. Valid values:

Healthy: sets the instance to the healthy state.
Unhealthy: sets the instance to the unhealthy state
parameters.help_zh:
设置实例的健康状态，取值范围：

Healthy：设置为健康状态。
Unhealthy：设置为不健康状态
parameters.name: health_status
